notes.title: May Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’re super excited to announce that Monorail Stories will be in Indie Live Expo. You can tune into Indie Live Expo here: https://indie.live-expo.games/en/ 

We’ve been hard at work lately and want to show off some things we’ve done. We hope you’re just as excited as we are!

Now, the game not only can played in single player, but we added an innovative asynchronous multiplayer mode for 2 players. What’s the difference?

In the single player story mode, player will take alternating control of the two characters in their respective daily runs. In this case, the player makes choices for both characters and then knows which action caused a certain consequence in the next leg.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37684005/0207495650dd5a58220fd501328eb91aee012247.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37684005/6d8471e4125e65fceeb7842c069b7466a778775b.png[/img]

In the async-multiplayer mode, two different players take turns controlling the two main characters. It's cooperative and the choices made by one player in his turn will impact how the story plays out for the other player. So, in this case the player only sees the story and makes decisions from only one point of view with no idea of the actions that the other player will do during their turn. This means you can play it online (with friends/strangers) and on Twitch! 

Monorail Stories features some friendly feline pals like the ones below!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37684005/16328fb799973976086277ad2a379e580a54b814.gif[/img]

Thank you so much for your support and we’ll see you at Indie Live Expo!

Don’t forget to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/nz3EKpYScw]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StelexSoftware]Twitter[/url], and check out our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/stelexsoftware/monorail-stories]Kickstarter page[/url].

notes.title: March Dev Update
notes.content:
Good day passengers welcome on board the Monorail. Beginning with March, we will be releasing monthly updates related to our game, providing you with a look behind the scenes of making an indie game, lore that will help jump right into the game on release, and various additional goodies, starting with a 4K render of the beautiful Mountain Cities of L and M.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37684005/6ebcfc53c8832890ab9ed1edb974abbfe8725f47.png[/img]
[i]Those familiar with the demo will recognize it as the background for the main menu.[/i]

The setting of Monorail Stories is a world different from our own, divided not into countries, but independent city-states, much like in the Middle Ages. Each city is a democratic state, with the governing City Hall administration elected by the city's inhabitants. Every citizen is enfranchised, and this empowerment helped each city develop its own unique society, economy, culture, and a mean independent streak.

L and M, the two city-stars of Monorail Stories, share common roots going back five hundred years. These close ties and their proximity led to strife and conflict between the cities and their citizens for a long long time. Until the advent of the Monorail.

You see, the Monorail isn't simply a sophisticated method of transporting people between the cities. It is a symbol of unity and cooperation against all odds, literally bridging the gap between the Cities of L and M. It is unique across the world, with neither other Mountain Cities nor the Continental States having anything like it.

Like any symbol of unity and concord, it was controversial on the day of its inauguration. In fact, it still is in some circles, as some scars do not heal and certain injuries are impossible to forget...

____________________________________________________________________
If you want to join our community and hang out with the devs, join our [url=https://discord.gg/nz3EKpYScw]Discord[/url]!
You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/StelexSoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/stelexsoftware]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/stelexsoftware/]Instagram[/url]!

notes.title: Monorail Stories has a Publisher!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that [b]Monorail Stories is now being published by Freedom Games [/b]( [url=https://freedom.gg]https://freedom.gg[/url] ). 
For those of you who may not know, a game publisher not only provides additional investment and funding for developing the game, but also takes care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. Really it lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides us with the resources to do so. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37684005/adba6e33ae49cc2ee98f6e038b2e098aa27c4172.png[/img]

We’re still working hard on the game and currently plan to be able to bring it to you all sometime in 2022. We can’t wait to share this game with you all and have you be a part of this story. Thank you for all of the support you've given us. If you want to keep up with our development progress a bit closer, make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/StelexSoftware]Twitter[/url]. While you’re here on Steam, make sure to wishlist the game as well!

notes.title: Monorail Stories finalist at the Digital Dragons's Indie Celebration Competition
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that Monorail Stories is part of the [b]Digital Dragons's 2021 Indie Celebration Competition[/b]!

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7875f4_01044abf56354a29bca1bfaa0d0fadd3~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_666,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/7875f4_01044abf56354a29bca1bfaa0d0fadd3~mv2.webp[/img]

The organizer of [url=https://digitaldragons.pl/]Digital Dragons 2021[/url], Krakow Technology Park has announced the finalists of Indie Celebration 2021, the upcoming event to celebrate the best indie games. Indie Celebration is an international competition where independent developers present their games to a selected audience of industry peers, veterans, and experts and win prestigious awards. This year’s event supported by co-organizers from Reboot – Adria Games Initiative and DevGAMM.

For this year’s competition, game developers from over 50 countries submitted over 250 games. The contest jury after testing each of these titles has picked 60 finalists which will be presented to a wider audience on Steam during the May 13 -14 Indie Celebration festival.

[b]Community Vote Award[/b]

Most of the games will also have playable demos during the event so that players can try out the titles before voting for the best game for the Community Vote Award.

You can already vote for Monorail Stories here: [url=http://bit.ly/IC_Vote]http://bit.ly/IC_Vote[/url]

So please... VOTE AND SPREAD THE WORD! :)

notes.title: Monorail Stories FINALIST at the prestigious "GDC Pitch" event!
notes.content:
Game Developers Conference are excited to confirm that the popular [url=https://www.gdconf.com/gdc-pitch?_mc=blog_x_gama_le_x_gdcsf_x_x-54-gdcs20]GDC Pitch[/url] event will return in a special online-only format for next week's all-digital [url=https://gdconf.com/?_mc=blog_x_gdcsfr_le_x_gdcsf_x_x-54-gdc20]GDC Summer[/url]!

If you've never seen it before, you should, because GDC Pitch is a special event designed to help select participants practice their game-pitching skills in front of a live audience!

It's a rare opportunity to hone the skills that help you make a great pitch, which can in turn secure the future of your studio, or ensure your game has the resources to reach the players who will appreciate it most.

GDC Pitch will once again be hosted by Jason Della Rocca of investment platform Execution Labs and take place at 12:30 PM Pacific next Tuesday and Wednesday (August 4th and 5th) during GDC Summer.

10 selected teams have been offered pitch prep and training, and each will get 5 minutes next week to make their pitch, followed by questions, advice, and feedback from the judges. The judges will declare a "Best Pitch" on each day, and award each a complimentary All Access pass to GDC 2021.

Here's the list of industry experts who have signed on to help judge GDC Pitch @ GDC Summer:​

[list]
[*] Vic Bassey  (Raw Fury)
[*] Michael Cheung  (Makers Fund)
[*] Cassia Curran  (WINGS Interactive)
